name: manzai
structure: boke/tsukkomi — two-character setup → punchline → reaction loops
use_for: gag conversations: misunderstandings, puns, one character being absurd, the other correcting

roles.boke: The funny man. Says the silly thing, misses the obvious, takes words literally. Moods: confused, happy, excited, dizzy. Faces the tsukkomi.
roles.tsukkomi: The straight man. Retorts sharply, corrects, occasionally despairs. Moods: smug, shocked, angry, dead. Faces the boke. Shout-style bubbles fit the big retorts.

rhythm: Panel 1: boke states something absurd matter-of-factly (round bubble).
Panel 2: tsukkomi's first reaction — short retort or disbelief (round or whisper).
Panel 3: boke doubles down — escalates the absurdity (this is the biggest laugh line).
Panel 4: tsukkomi's full retort (shout) + reaction FX on the boke (fx/sweat, fx/q).
staging: Put both characters in every panel with layout: two-shot, facing each other; the boke's tail points at their own bubble, the tsukkomi's at theirs. Alternate which side speaks first.
